604-17.descricao: Relatório de tributos: visão consolidada por documento (BC/VLR de cada tributo) e layout igual ao do RB

visao.sql:
SELECT TMOVNFSE_1.NUMERONFSE, TMOV_1.NUMEROMOV,
       FCFO_1.CODCFO || ' - ' || COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(FCFO_1.NOMEFANTASIA), ''), FCFO_1.NOME) AS FORNECEDOR,
       TMOV_1.DATAEMISSAO, TMOV_1.DATAMOVIMENTO AS DATA_ENTRADA, TMOV_1.VALORLIQUIDO AS VALOR, TMOV_1.VALORBRUTO,
       (SELECT SUM(T.BASEDECALCULO) FROM TTRBMOV T WHERE T.IDMOV = TMOV_1.IDMOV AND T.CODEMPRESA = TMOV_1.CODEMPRESA AND T.CODTRB = 'ISSRET') AS BC_ISSRET,
       (SELECT SUM(T.VALOR) FROM TTRBMOV T WHERE T.IDMOV = TMOV_1.IDMOV AND T.CODEMPRESA = TMOV_1.CODEMPRESA AND T.CODTRB = 'ISSRET') AS VLR_ISSRET,
       (SELECT SUM(T.BASEDECALCULO) FROM TTRBMOV T WHERE T.IDMOV = TMOV_1.IDMOV AND T.CODEMPRESA = TMOV_1.CODEMPRESA AND T.CODTRB = 'ISS') AS BC_ISS,
       (SELECT SUM(T.VALOR) FROM TTRBMOV T WHERE T.IDMOV = TMOV_1.IDMOV AND T.CODEMPRESA = TMOV_1.CODEMPRESA AND T.CODTRB = 'ISS') AS VLR_ISS,
       (SELECT SUM(T.BASEDECALCULO) FROM TTRBMOV T WHERE T.IDMOV = TMOV_1.IDMOV AND T.CODEMPRESA = TMOV_1.CODEMPRESA AND T.CODTRB = 'INSSRET') AS BC_INSSRET,
       (SELECT SUM(T.VALOR) FROM TTRBMOV T WHERE T.IDMOV = TMOV_1.IDMOV AND T.CODEMPRESA = TMOV_1.CODEMPRESA AND T.CODTRB = 'INSSRET') AS VLR_INSSRET,
       (SELECT SUM(T.BASEDECALCULO) FROM TTRBMOV T WHERE T.IDMOV = TMOV_1.IDMOV AND T.CODEMPRESA = TMOV_1.CODEMPRESA AND T.CODTRB = 'IRPJRET') AS BC_IRPJRET,
       (SELECT SUM(T.VALOR) FROM TTRBMOV T WHERE T.IDMOV = TMOV_1.IDMOV AND T.CODEMPRESA = TMOV_1.CODEMPRESA AND T.CODTRB = 'IRPJRET') AS VLR_IRPJRET,
       (SELECT SUM(T.BASEDECALCULO) FROM TTRBMOV T WHERE T.IDMOV = TMOV_1.IDMOV AND T.CODEMPRESA = TMOV_1.CODEMPRESA AND T.CODTRB = 'PIS') AS BC_PIS,
       (SELECT SUM(T.VALOR) FROM TTRBMOV T WHERE T.IDMOV = TMOV_1.IDMOV AND T.CODEMPRESA = TMOV_1.CODEMPRESA AND T.CODTRB = 'PIS') AS VLR_PIS,
       (SELECT SUM(T.BASEDECALCULO) FROM TTRBMOV T WHERE T.IDMOV = TMOV_1.IDMOV AND T.CODEMPRESA = TMOV_1.CODEMPRESA AND T.CODTRB = 'COFINS') AS BC_COFINS,
       (SELECT SUM(T.VALOR) FROM TTRBMOV T WHERE T.IDMOV = TMOV_1.IDMOV AND T.CODEMPRESA = TMOV_1.CODEMPRESA AND T.CODTRB = 'COFINS') AS VLR_COFINS,
       (SELECT SUM(T.BASEDECALCULO) FROM TTRBMOV T WHERE T.IDMOV = TMOV_1.IDMOV AND T.CODEMPRESA = TMOV_1.CODEMPRESA AND T.CODTRB = 'CSLL') AS BC_CSLL,
       (SELECT SUM(T.VALOR) FROM TTRBMOV T WHERE T.IDMOV = TMOV_1.IDMOV AND T.CODEMPRESA = TMOV_1.CODEMPRESA AND T.CODTRB = 'CSLL') AS VLR_CSLL
FROM TMOV TMOV_1 LEFT OUTER JOIN FCFO FCFO_1 ON
     (FCFO_1.CODEMPRESA = TMOV_1.CODEMPRESA)
      AND (FCFO_1.CODCFO = TMOV_1.CODCFO)
      LEFT OUTER JOIN TMOVNFSE TMOVNFSE_1 ON
     (TMOVNFSE_1.IDMOV = TMOV_1.IDMOV)
WHERE ( (CAST(:CODIGO_TIPO_MOVIMENTO AS VARCHAR(2000)) IS NULL OR POSITION(',' || TRIM(TMOV_1.CODTMV) || ',' IN ',' || REPLACE(CAST(:CODIGO_TIPO_MOVIMENTO AS VARCHAR(2000)), ' ', '') || ',') > 0) ) AND ( TMOV_1.STATUS <> 'C' ) AND ( (CAST(:DATA_MOVIMENTO_DE AS DATE) IS NULL OR TMOV_1.DATAMOVIMENTO >= CAST(:DATA_MOVIMENTO_DE AS DATE)) AND (CAST(:DATA_MOVIMENTO_ATE AS DATE) IS NULL OR TMOV_1.DATAMOVIMENTO < CAST(:DATA_MOVIMENTO_ATE AS DATE) + 1) ) AND ( (CAST(:DATA_DE_EMISSAO_DE AS DATE) IS NULL OR TMOV_1.DATAEMISSAO >= CAST(:DATA_DE_EMISSAO_DE AS DATE)) AND (CAST(:DATA_DE_EMISSAO_ATE AS DATE) IS NULL OR TMOV_1.DATAEMISSAO < CAST(:DATA_DE_EMISSAO_ATE AS DATE) + 1) ) AND ( (CAST(:STATUSNFSE AS DOUBLE PRECISION) IS NULL OR TMOVNFSE_1.STATUSNFSE <> CAST(:STATUSNFSE AS DOUBLE PRECISION)) )
ORDER BY TMOV_1.DATAEMISSAO, TMOVNFSE_1.NUMERONFSE
